onboarding.label: Getting started
onboarding.title: Get to know SiYe with one search
onboarding.description: Connect the platforms you use, then search for something you care about. Follow four short steps or skip whenever you like.
onboarding.connectBody: Choose a platform on the accounts page below, click Scan to log in, and scan with its mobile app. One or two platforms are enough to start. Continue after login is confirmed. Finish login or close the login window before searching.
onboarding.searchBody: The four platform buttons below the search box set this search's scope. They are checkboxes, not status lights: platforms marked ✓ are included, and unmarked ones are skipped this round (clear a platform you haven't logged into so it doesn't fail). Nothing is pre-selected on first open — you pick what to search, and if you leave all unchecked, searching prompts you to choose at least one. Pick only platforms you connected, enter a keyword, then press Enter or the arrow to search. Results arrive progressively. Next to the sort dropdown there is a separate input for filtering results by keyword; you can also switch platforms or sort by relevance, recency, or engagement, open a title to read the source, or expand its available text. Each platform has its own status block, and a failed one can be retried on its own.
onboarding.emptyPlatformPrompt: Select at least one platform before searching — these are checkboxes, not status lights.
onboarding.saveBody: Use the bookmark icon on a search result to save it. Local favorites supports collections, notes, and backups. Remote favorites lets you manually sync items saved on each platform. If your library is empty, return to search and save a result.
onboarding.helpBody: Restart this tutorial or copy diagnostics from Help. Settings lets you change search limits, home page content, and appearance. You are ready to explore SiYe.
onboarding.replayHint: Try each step at your own pace, then select Next. You can always restart from Help.
onboarding.helpIntro: Learn about accounts, search, favorites, and help in four optional steps. Finishing stops automatic reminders.
onboarding.storageUnavailable: The browser could not save your preference. The tutorial is closed for now, but may appear next time.

support.title: Need help? Include diagnostics
support.description: Copy your local environment, login verification status, and the status and timing of recent searches and favorites syncs. A preview appears after capture.
support.privacy: Reports exclude cookies, account names, queries, result text, saved content, file paths, and raw logs. Capture does not search platforms or upload anything.
support.copied: Diagnostics copied. Review the report below before pasting it into your feedback.
support.copyFailed: The report is ready, but clipboard access was denied. Select and copy it manually, or download the file.
support.failed: Diagnostics could not be generated. Try again or describe the problem directly.
support.downloadFailed: Download failed. You can select and copy the report below.
support.snapshotHint: This is a local snapshot, not a live platform check. unavailable means a read failed; empty means no record; null means unknown. Recent search records may be empty after restarting.
